Fine Park (Japanese: ファインパーク Fine Park) is an abandoned amusement park in the game . It is located west of central Ryme in the Fork Hand district . It was closed down a year ago after an incident involving a ; however, a few Pokémon still remain there. It lies opposite (Japanese: ショータイムアベニュー Showtime Avenue) which had previously been lined with many popular theaters and cafés. Most of Chapter 5 takes place here.
